newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 30-day Bank Negara bills yield 6.399 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 30-day Bank Negara bills yield 6.399 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's central bank said on Tuesday it accepted bids at an average yield of 6.399 percent at its auction of 30-day Bank Negara bills for 500 million ringgit.
At its previous auction on April 1 for 30-day bills worth 500 million, the central bank accepted bids at an average yield of 6.384 percent.
The central bank said bids accepted were in a high/low range of 6.409/370 percent, compared with 6.400/351 previously.
Bank Negara bills are issued by the central bank usually to keep a check on liquidity. It also issues treasury bills on behalf of the federal government.
